text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I've no doubt that I made every effort I
could in
preparation. I held nothing back
during the race
either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's that my light remains too
faint...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: Let's figure out how to win together.
It was purely a lack of ability.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Please do provide me with
all the
knowledge and wisdom you can.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall redouble my efforts, so please
continue to
advise me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...! ...Yes, you're absolutely correct.
Although I exhausted my strength, there
was still quite a gap
between me and the
competition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should have trained more, but
I do not
wish to use my health as an
excuse.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall fully devote myself to winning the
next
race, so please continue to support
my efforts.
